id.description: Globally unique message identifier (ULID/UUID); stable across the message's lifetime and independent of any transport identifier.

type.description: One of the seven provider-neutral message kinds enumerated by Memo 10 sections 9-10.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the message was minted.

pico.description: Stable Pico identity of the emitter. Independent of MQTT client_id, Kubernetes pod name, IP address, or any transport-specific identifier.

transport.description: Transport-scoped identifiers. Distinct from source.pico; may vary across sessions.

target.description: Required for command and delegation; must name the recipient Pico by stable identity.

subject.description: What the message is about (device path, mission id, Pico resource, etc.).

correlation_id.description: Groups related messages that belong to the same mission or interaction (e.g. delegation and its result share a correlation_id).

causation_id.description: The id of the message that directly caused this one (e.g. an event caused by an observation, a result caused by a delegation).

delegation.description: Delegation context. Present on delegation messages; carried on the paired result message so the outcome can be attributed.

principal.description: The identity on whose behalf the action is taken (user, Pico, service account).

capability.description: The capability being exercised (e.g. pico.state.set, garden.water).

granted_by.description: Ruleset or policy that granted the capability.

authorization.description: Required for command and delegation. Publishing to a topic is not itself authorization; the emitter must show which principal is acting and which capability is being invoked.

data.description: Type-specific payload; validated by the emitter's Ruleset, not by this envelope schema.
